Hi Sofia —

Thanks for the time last week. We'd love to get a live walkthrough of Redwood in front of your ops and systems teams so they can see latency/cost tradeoffs on your workload. I know you mentioned travel next week; quick options below so we can avoid constant reschedules: 

- Option A: Mon 26 Jul, 10:00–10:45 PT (before you leave)
- Option B: Tue 27 Jul, 08:00–08:45 PT (you may be in transit)
- Option C: Tue 3 Aug, 10:00–10:45 PT (after travel, same slot we use for other accounts)

If none work, tell me two 45-minute windows that fit your travel cadence and we’ll align. I can bring Ben for the architecture deep-dive and Laura to cover onboarding/ops questions.

I attached a short agenda and one-pager so your team knows what to expect.

Attachments: demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 42 KB), redwood-one-pager.pdf (PDF, 28 KB)

Best,
Mateo Alvarez

- Best: Tue 3 Aug after 09:30 PT
